user.title: Window Airing
user.description: What do you want to add? Rooms are monitored one by one. The house entry is optional and unique: it adds the winter mode for all rooms.

room.title: Window Airing — room
room.description: Pick the room to monitor and the shared outdoor temperature source: a temperature sensor, or a weather entity (e.g. Met.no) when there is no outdoor probe. A rain sensor is optional. Window contacts, indoor temperature and climate are auto-discovered from the room.

data.rain_sensor: Rain sensor (binary_sensor or numeric mm, optional)

house.title: Window Airing — house
house.description: Pick the climates to watch for the automatic switch to winter. Leave empty to only use the switch by hand. Thresholds, months and reminders are set afterwards in Configure.

data.heating_climates: Climates that drive the automatic season change

abort.already_configured: This room already has a Window Airing entry.

init.title: Window Airing — settings

data.use_trend: Also alert when indoor temperature is rising
data.rain_mm_threshold: Rain threshold for a numeric sensor (mm)
data.winter_cut_heat_only: Winter: also turn off heat-only devices

house.title: Window Airing — house
house.description: Automatic changes only happen during their period: winter from its start month to the summer one, summer from its start month to the winter one. The switch works by hand all year round. The maximum open time is the Maximum open time in winter entity.

data.heating_climates: Climates that drive the automatic season change
data.winter_heating_minutes: Daily heating time that switches to winter (min)
data.summer_idle_days: Days without heating that switch back to summer (0 = never)
data.winter_max_reminders: Winter reminders after the first alert (0 = none)

error.same_month: The two months must be different.
